account_holder.description: Account holder's name as printed in the statement header.

account_type.description: Account type as printed, e.g. Premiere Select Rollover IRA.

broker_dealer.description: Broker-dealer the securities are offered through.

custodian.description: Firm the account is carried with (clearing firm or custodian).

advisory_firm.description: Wealth management or advisory firm named on the statement.

period_start_date.description: First day of the statement period, as YYYY-MM-DD.

period_end_date.description: Last day of the statement period, as YYYY-MM-DD.

beginning_value.description: Beginning value of the portfolio for the period, in dollars.

ending_value.description: Total value of the portfolio at the end of the period, in dollars.

change_in_value.description: The Change in Account Value table, current period column, exactly as printed.

taxes_fees_expenses.description: Taxes, fees and expenses, in dollars, negative if printed in parentheses.

contributions_current_year.description: Contributions for the current year, year-to-date, in dollars.

contributions_prior_year.description: Contributions for the prior year, year-to-date, in dollars.

distributions_current_year.description: Distributions for the current year, year-to-date, in dollars.

allocation.description: Every asset class in the Account Allocation table.

holdings.description: Every security in Holdings, including the cash sweep.

description.description: Security description, joined into one line if it wraps.

price.description: Price at the end of the period, in dollars.

estimated_annual_income.description: Estimated annual income, in dollars, or null if not printed.

beneficiaries.description: Every designated beneficiary in the Beneficiary Summary.
